file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Aston University Medicine MBChB A100. This file records current and historical official evidence, route scope, unresolved conflicts and prediction blockers. It is not the production admissions rules file and does not treat the existing MSC seed profile as executable evidence.

research_scope.cycle_caveat: The research-team evidence package confirms validity for 2026 and 2027 entry. Historical interview and offer thresholds remain descriptive cycle evidence rather than fixed current cutoffs.
research_scope.notes: The standard Home/RUK school-leaver route was researched first. Official rules, FOI evidence and historical modelling inputs are classified separately. UCAT values supplied on or converted to the 2700 scale are labelled, and no fixed current cutoff is asserted.

evidence_classification_policy.official: Directly stated in a first-party Aston University source. Cycle applicability is recorded separately and may be current, historical or unclear.
evidence_classification_policy.FOI: Directly supported by an Aston Freedom of Information response supplied by the research team.
evidence_classification_policy.research_derived: A calculation or modelling interpretation derived by ApplySmart from cited evidence; it is not an Aston rule.
evidence_classification_policy.inferred: A reasonable interpretation of official text that Aston does not state explicitly. It must not be implemented as an official rule.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: No sufficiently explicit evidence was found.

readiness.eligibility_ready_scope: Published standard Home school-leaver, Home WP, standard and contextual IB, Scottish National 5/Higher/Advanced Higher, exact BTEC combination, graduate A100, Aston Healthcare Foundation Year, Access rejection, resit, repeat-application, named international-equivalence and IELTS rules are evidenced. Unlisted international qualifications and ambiguous mixed routes remain manual review.
readiness.interview_prediction_ready_scope: Home non-contextual and Home WP predictions may use the verified 36-point formula and group-specific historical thresholds. International predictions may use verified UCAT-only guidance and distributions; an International 36-point combined model remains blocked pending metric clarification.
interview_prediction_caveats: No fixed current UCAT or combined-score cutoff exists; any prediction must use labelled historical group thresholds and guidance, not present them as guaranteed current cutoffs.
The supplied 2026+ values are guidance rather than an achieved-cycle outcome and must be distinguished from 2022-2025 history.
The below-1650 UCAT band is only described as below seven points; exact points below seven are not supplied.
readiness.summary: The supplied official and FOI package resolves the Home/WP 36-point pre-interview formula, UCAT point bands, separate pools, tie-breakers and multi-cycle historical thresholds. Scoped eligibility and interview guidance are active.

applicant_groups_and_supported_scope.official_treatment: Home non-widening-participation applicants are checked against minimum requirements and ranked separately using achieved academic qualifications and total UCAT score.
No separate RUK pool or RUK-specific rule is published. ApplySmart treats RUK as Home fee scope only because Aston's published grouping is Home, WP and International.

Eligible Home applicants are ranked separately in the WP group and may receive the AAB contextual offer with AA in Chemistry and Biology. Aston aims to offer up to 40% of UK places to applicants meeting specified widening-participation criteria.

International and Overseas/Overseas Unknown applicants are ranked separately for MMI using total UCAT score only, while still having to meet GCSE or equivalent requirements. EU applicants are included in the international fee pool unless assessed as Home.

Graduates and applicants in the final year of a degree may apply to A100 if they meet the graduate requirements. There is no accelerated graduate-entry route and successful graduate applicants complete the same five-year programme.
Only Aston's own Healthcare Foundation Year is accepted. External foundation years are not accepted. The Aston route requires BBB at A level including Chemistry and Biology, UCAT and MMI.

general_gate.rule: Applicants must meet the relevant minimum academic requirements, supply a complete UCAS application, take UCAT or UCATSEN in the same year as the application and satisfy fitness-to-practise requirements.

predicted_grades.rule: A-level predicted grades are required in a complete application when the qualification is in progress but are not used in scoring or at any stage of selection. The predicted degree class is considered for applicants in the final year of an undergraduate degree.

personal_statement_and_reference.rule: The personal statement is mandatory but is not scored at the first stage. It is read with the reference to confirm a suitable academic reference and identify fitness-to-practise or other concerns. References should normally come from the current or most recent academic institution, or from a current employer when an academic reference is not possible after more than five years out of education.

excluded_applicant_history.rule: Aston does not accept applicants currently or previously enrolled on Medicine, applicants who withdrew from any degree, applicants seeking transfer from another degree, applicants not in the final year of a current degree, or applicants previously rejected because of one or more MMI red flags.

deferred_entry.rule: Deferred entry and gap years are permitted through UCAS. Post-offer deferral requests are considered case by case. Interview, UCAT, academic qualifications and other offer conditions must be obtained in the year of application; occupational-health and DBS checks must be repeated before deferred entry.

minimum_rule.rule: A minimum of six GCSEs or IGCSEs at grade 6/B or above, including English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry and Biology, or English Language, Mathematics and Double Science.

counted_subjects: Double Science as two subjects, or separate Chemistry and Biology
current_pre_interview_academic_scoring.used_for: Home non-contextual and Home WP pre-interview ranking. A-level and IB predicted grades are not used.

counted_subjects: Double Science as two subjects, or separate Chemistry and Biology
Double Science as two subjects, or separate Chemistry and Biology

standard_school_leaver.third_subject_rule: Any third subject except General Studies or Critical Thinking.
standard_school_leaver.A_star_rule: The A* must be in Chemistry or Biology.
standard_school_leaver.practical_rule: Passes in the practical elements are required where available.
standard_school_leaver.more_than_three_a_levels: Chemistry, Biology and the next best grade are considered.

achieved_a_level_scoring_non_resit.counted_subjects: Chemistry, Biology and the highest-grade other A level.
achieved_a_level_scoring_non_resit.notes: The published standard minimum is A*AA, so a qualifying achieved standard profile receives the full 12 A-level points under the table.

contextual_achieved_a_level_scoring_non_.rule: WP applicants with the required AAB are awarded 12 A-level points.

international_baccalaureate.standard_requirement: 37 overall with Higher Level grades 7, 6, 6; Higher Level subjects must include Chemistry and Biology, and the 7 must be in Chemistry or Biology.
international_baccalaureate.ib_middle_years_requirement: Grade 4 in Mathematics; Home applicants also require grade 4 in English, while International applicants must meet the relevant IELTS requirement.
international_baccalaureate.wp_requirement: 35 points overall with Higher Level grades 6, 6, 5 including Chemistry and Biology.

scottish_advanced_highers.requirement: AAA at Scottish Advanced Higher, including Chemistry and Biology.
scottish_advanced_highers.national_5_requirements: At least six National 5 qualifications at grade B or above, including English, Mathematics, and Chemistry plus Biology or an accepted Combined/Double Science equivalent at B/B.

btec.requirement: DDD in the BTEC National Extended Diploma in Applied Science combined with Chemistry and Biology A levels at A*A in either order.

t_levels.requirement: T levels are not accepted for MBChB.
t_levels.mixed_t_level_and_a_level_cases: Applicants are directed to Admissions for individual advice.

access_to_he.requirement: Aston does not currently accept any Access courses for MBChB.

foundation_programmes.requirement: Only Aston's own Healthcare Foundation Year is accepted. It requires BBB at A level including Chemistry and Biology, UCAT and MMI. External foundation years are not accepted.

graduate_a100.degree_requirement: At least an upper second-class Honours degree (2:1) in any discipline from a UK ENIC-recognised university.
graduate_a100.school_qualification_requirement: Three A levels at ABB including Chemistry and Biology, with grade A in at least one of Chemistry or Biology, plus the standard GCSE minimum.
graduate_a100.application_timing: Applicants must have completed the degree or be in its final year.
graduate_a100.programme_length: Five years; no accelerated graduate entry.

academic_scoring.a_level_points: A*, A and B each receive 2 points across Chemistry, Biology and one other A level.
academic_scoring.postgraduate_degree_rule: Applicants with an MSc or PhD are scored using their BSc.

resits.rule: Applicants who have resat or are resitting GCSEs, A levels or accepted equivalent qualifications are considered, with or without repeating an academic year. The final qualification profile must normally be achieved within no more than three academic years, allowing one resit-year attempt.
resits.selection_scoring_effect: Applicants resitting A levels or equivalent examinations such as IB are scored on GCSEs only.
resits.extenuating_circumstances: Extenuating circumstances are not considered in scoring and ranking.

repeat_application.rejected_pre_interview: May reapply in the next application cycle.
repeat_application.rejected_post_interview: Must wait one full application cycle before reapplying.
repeat_application.mmi_red_flag_rule: Applicants previously rejected because of one or more MMI red flags are excluded.

scope.rule: All Home fee applicants are reviewed for Medicine WP eligibility except applicants in the final year of a degree, applicants who already hold a degree and applicants who attended an independent school. State grammar school applicants remain eligible for consideration.

criteria: Lives in a POLAR quintile 1 or 2 or IMD quintile 1 or 2 postcode.
Received Free School Meals within the previous six years.
First generation in the family to enter higher education.
Completed Aston Ready or Aston Pathways.

academic_adjustment.contextual_a_level_offer: AAB with AA in Chemistry and Biology

selection_treatment.rule: WP applicants are ranked separately from Home non-WP and International applicants.
selection_treatment.target: Up to 44 WP offers within 110 Home places.

international_selection.rule: Applicants classified as Overseas or Overseas Unknown are ranked for MMI by total UCAT score only, although they must still meet GCSE or equivalent minimum requirements. International qualifications are mapped to UK equivalents by Admissions with UK ENIC input.

published_international_qualification_sc.rule: A levels require A*AA with the A* in Chemistry or Biology. IB requires at least 37 overall with Higher Level 7, 6, 6 including Chemistry and Biology. US applicants require a 4.0 High School GPA plus three AP scores of 5, 5, 5 including Chemistry and Biology. India CBSE applicants require at least a 90% average across five subjects with Chemistry and Biology each at 90% or above. All international qualifications are mapped through UK ENIC.
published_routes: US High School Diploma plus AP

ielts.validity: The English-language test must be taken within two years of the course start date.

lower_gcse_english_with_ielts_scoring.rule: An applicant with a lower GCSE English Language grade and achieved IELTS may be scored using IELTS equivalence. The scoring page lists IELTS 9/8.5 as A*, 8/7.5 as A, 7/6.5 as B and 6/5.5 as C, but also says an offer holder with 6.5 in any component will be asked to retake.
lower_gcse_english_with_ielts_scoring.conflict_note: The current university English requirement for Aston Medical School is 7.0 overall and 7.0 in every component. The lower-component scoring table must not override that eligibility requirement.

requirement.rule: All applicants must take UCAT or, where appropriate, UCATSEN in the same year as their application.
requirement.target_cycle_test_year_basis: A September 2027 entrant applies in 2026; the test-year value follows Aston's same-year-of-application rule.

cognitive_total.use: Only the cognitive total contributes. For Home and WP it is converted to a maximum of 12 points and added to the GCSE academic score out of 24. International applicants remain in a separate pool.

subsection_minimums.rule: There is no UCAT cognitive-subsection minimum.

current_cutoff.rule: Aston states that it does not provide a specific UCAT score requirement and does not have a lower UCAT cutoff because UCAT is considered with other entry requirements. The effective current interview rank boundary is therefore dynamic and unknown.

sjt_band_policy.rule: SJT banding is not scored and is not considered in ranking. Aston's UCAT advice also says there is no lower SJT cutoff.

rules: Minimum qualifications, personal statement and reference are checked.
Home and WP applicants are ranked using achieved academic qualifications and total UCAT score within separate groups.
International applicants are ranked using total UCAT score only after minimum academic checks.
The highest-ranked applicants in each group are invited to MMI.

ranking_method.rule: Applicants are ranked from highest to lowest within separate Home non-contextual, Home WP and International lists. Scores are not compared across groups. The WP group has its own lower historical invitation threshold.

place_context.notes: The supplied official research package confirms these values for 2027.

pre_interview: Review of personal statement and reference.
tie_breakers.pre_interview_reserve_list: Borderline applicants are held on a pre-interview reserve list and may be invited if higher-ranked applicants decline.
tie_breakers.post_interview_reserve_list: Applicants below the offer threshold are ranked on a reserve list which is activated if offers are declined.

format.timing: Normally December to March in the application year.
format.station_mechanics: Several stations assess different attributes; some may use actors or a scenario to read and discuss.
format.overall_score: Performance is combined into a total score out of 45.

attributes: awareness of limitations and when to ask for help

historical_2025_structure.station_count_note: Five stations is a mathematical inference from the official total maximum of 50 and maximum of 10 per station; it is historical only and is not asserted as the current format.

summary_process.rule: From 2025 onwards, final ranking combines academic score, UCAT and MMI in a 2:1:1 weighting and maintains separate Home non-contextual, Home WP and International ranking lists.

detailed_scoring_process.rule: Final ranking weights academic score at 50%, UCAT at 25% and MMI at 25%. MMI is scaled to 0-36 to align with the pre-interview total. The earlier MMI-only guidance is superseded and must not be used.

resolved_operational_formula.reserve_list_method: Applicants below the group offer threshold are ranked and activated if offers are declined.

conditions: satisfactory Enhanced DBS check or international police check

historical_evidence_policy.rule: Observed 2022-2025 group thresholds and score distributions are historical evidence, not fixed current cutoffs. Research-team-supplied UCAT conversions to the 2700 scale may be retained alongside original 3600-scale values. The 2026+ figures are guidance and must not be represented as achieved outcomes.

historical_admissions_evidence.notes: Aston explicitly says the 2025 values illustrate that year and do not guarantee or predict future outcomes.

historical_ucat_data.notes: Aston explicitly warns that the 2025 figures are not guarantees or predictors for later cycles. They cannot support current interview bands without an approved methodology and additional evidence.

historical_interview_data.notes: These official historical distributions are retained as descriptive evidence. The current 2:1:1 offer formula is resolved by the later Aston FAQ and FOI update; observed score minima remain historical rather than fixed current thresholds.

historical_pre_interview_thresholds.notes: All converted values are stored exactly as supplied by the research team. ApplySmart must not recalculate, repair or present them as current fixed cutoffs.

foi_evidence.repository_search_result: Aston FOI evidence was supplied directly by the research team for this upgrade; the underlying publication URLs were not included in the package.
interview_prediction_foi_targets: No critical FOI target remains. Future cycles should refresh group application volumes, interview volumes and observed invitation boundaries.
offer_prediction_foi_targets: No critical FOI target remains. Future cycles should refresh group offer thresholds and reserve-list outcomes and confirm the MMI scaling rounding convention.

conflict_audit.evidence_a: The course URL and start-date selector identify September 2027 entry.
conflict_audit.evidence_b: The same page says applicants must take UCAT in 2025 for 2026 entry.
conflict_audit.handling: The supplied official/FOI package confirms validity for 2026-2027 entry. Preserve the stale-page note for provenance but use the confirmed cycle applicability.

conflict_audit.evidence_a: The admissions summary says applicants are re-ranked using total MMI score and top-ranked applicants receive offers.
conflict_audit.evidence_b: The detailed scoring section says offers are based on academic, UCAT and MMI scores.
conflict_audit.handling: Use the current 50% academic, 25% UCAT and 25% MMI formula. The earlier MMI-only statement is superseded and must not be implemented.

conflict_audit.evidence_a: The general UCAT advice page still describes four timed subtests in wording inherited from the older UCAT format.
conflict_audit.evidence_b: The current scoring FAQ explicitly scores Verbal Reasoning, Quantitative Reasoning and Decision Making out of 2700 and separately excludes SJT from scoring.
conflict_audit.handling: Use the explicit current scoring FAQ for the cognitive total and keep the advice page only for the same-year test rule and no-cutoff statement.

conflict_audit.evidence_a: The scoring FAQ maps IELTS component scores as low as 5.5 to GCSE-grade equivalents and says a 6.5 component may be retaken after an offer.
conflict_audit.evidence_b: The current university English-language table requires IELTS 7.0 overall and 7.0 in every component for Aston Medical School.
conflict_audit.handling: Treat 7.0 in every component as the eligibility requirement. Do not use the equivalence scoring table to lower English eligibility.

conflict_audit.evidence_a: The existing official FAQ evidence states that International applicants are ranked by UCAT cognitive total only after eligibility checks.
conflict_audit.evidence_b: The supplied FOI historical interview table labels International minimum scores on the same 36-point combined scale used for Home and WP.
conflict_audit.handling: Preserve International as a separate UCAT-only production model unless Aston explicitly confirms that the 36-point academic-plus-UCAT formula also applies. International prediction may use its supplied UCAT distributions and observed minima, but must not calculate an International combined score from this conflict.

unresolved_gaps.description: Aston has no fixed current UCAT or combined-score cutoff. The supplied 2026+ group figures are guidance, not achieved-cycle outcomes.
unresolved_gaps.prediction_impact: Does not block banded prediction, but predictions must be probabilistic or guidance-based and must not claim a guaranteed current cutoff.

unresolved_gaps.description: The current UCAT table describes scores below 1650 only as below seven points or low band; it does not supply exact point values.
unresolved_gaps.prediction_impact: Applicants below 1650 require conservative handling or manual review in exact-score calculation.

unresolved_gaps.description: MMI is scaled from 0-45 to 0-36 for final ranking, but the supplied evidence does not state the rounding or precision convention.
unresolved_gaps.prediction_impact: Does not block offer modelling away from a boundary; exact boundary ties require conservative handling.

unresolved_gaps.description: A level, IB, US High School plus AP and India CBSE routes are evidenced, but a complete country-specific qualification catalogue is not supplied.
unresolved_gaps.prediction_impact: Unlisted international qualifications require manual review and UK ENIC mapping.

unresolved_gaps.description: The existing official FAQ says International ranking is UCAT-only, while the supplied historical FOI table reports International minimum scores out of 36.
unresolved_gaps.prediction_impact: International UCAT-guidance prediction is supported, but an International 36-point combined model must not be implemented until clarified.

unresolved_gaps.description: IELTS is explicit, but the supplied upgrade does not provide executable thresholds for every alternative English test or exemption.
unresolved_gaps.prediction_impact: Alternative tests and exemptions remain manual review.

unresolved_gaps.description: The research team identified official, FOI and MSC evidence classes but did not include publication URLs or FOI document identifiers for the new package.
unresolved_gaps.prediction_impact: Does not block research readiness, but source-document URLs should be attached before public audit or metadata activation.

official_formula_status.notes: The 36-point pre-interview model, 12-point UCAT table, group-specific history, 2:1:1 final formula and tie-breakers are verified. Banded prediction may now be designed; no historical minimum may be presented as a fixed current cutoff.

production_handoff_status.recommended_step_3_scope: Re-audit the existing production profile against the confirmed 36-point Home/WP pre-interview model, GCSE-only academic scoring, UCAT bands, 2027 WP and qualification rules, repeat policy, MMI format, post-interview 2:1:1 formula, tie-breakers and historical group guidance. Resolve the International metric conflict conservatively before production activation.
production_handoff_status.reason: The scoped production profile, interview-band configuration, result card, index metadata and regression coverage are active. Offer prediction remains disabled pending deterministic boundary handling and consumer acceptance.

do_not_infer: Do not use the MSC seed profile as executable evidence.
Do not treat any historical minimum interview or offer score as a fixed current cutoff.
Do not recalculate or silently repair the research-team-supplied UCAT conversions; preserve original and converted values as supplied.
Do not assign an exact UCAT point value below 1650 because the supplied table states only below seven points.
Do not normalise scores across Home non-contextual, Home WP and International pools.
Do not score SJT or reject SJT Band 4.
Do not treat predicted A-level grades as scoring inputs.
Do not add academic points to International pre-interview ranking until the conflict between the UCAT-only FAQ rule and FOI 36-point historical threshold is explicitly resolved.
Do not assume a separate RUK ranking pool.
Do not treat up to 44 WP offers as a guaranteed fixed quota.
Do not treat the historical inferred five-station format as current; current evidence states 8 to 10 stations and an MMI total out of 45.
Do not implement the superseded MMI-only offer-ranking statement.
Do not invent the MMI-to-36 rounding convention.
Do not activate interview or offer prediction until production re-audit, consumer support, band configuration where applicable and acceptance testing are complete.
Do not activate result-card or metadata readiness from research readiness alone.
